prompt: Read nonnegative n. Sum the squares of positive indices divisible by four up to n, then add 1.
target:

prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers as an array. Sum products of neighboring pairs, then add 15.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=15.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<3, i++) { total+=values[i]*values[i+1]. }
DISPLAYNL(total).
